description: Passive piezo buzzer (externally driven), Ø12 x 7.5 mm, through hole with pins 6.5 mm apart, 4 kHz resonance, 80 dB at 10 cm; pins A, B (no polarity)

datasheet.revision: INGHAi GPC12075YB-5V4000 specification for approval V1.1 (2014-01-10)

package.name: Ø12 mm buzzer, pins 6.5 mm apart
package.page: A: dimensions: Ø12 ± 0.2, 7.5 ± 0.2 high, 2 x Ø0.7 pins 6.5 ± 0.2 apart

notes: Passive: it sounds only when driven with an AC signal: a square wave from a GPIO (PWM, `tone()`), loudest near 4 kHz. Directly from the pin (it draws under 5 mA, a 10 nF load) between A and GND, or louder from a transistor stage.
An active buzzer (a built-in oscillator, sounds on DC) has the same body: this one needs the signal.

pins.source: INGHAi GPC12075YB-5V4000 specification: A. dimensions (Ø12, 7.5 mm, pins Ø0.7 at 6.5 mm), B. specifications

footprint.note: 1.0 mm holes and 1.8 mm pads our choice for the Ø0.7 pins
